topics.title: Holocaust Survivor Claims Bank Stonewalled Depositors
topics.summary: A Jewish group claims six hundred million dollars deposited during Hitler’s rise was stonewalled by a Swiss bank after the war, alleging they couldn't find the money. The offer to settle Holocaust survivor claims is considered laughable due to the immense loss and ongoing accusations against the institution.

topics.title: Lawyer, Stripper, Feces Incident
topics.summary: A former lawyer discusses her dissatisfaction with the legal profession and past experiences as a stripper before abruptly shifting to reporting on an incident where a defendant in a rape trial smeared human feces across his face during court proceedings. The segment then covers celebrity commentary regarding fame and privacy, concluding with news of a mistrial due to bizarre courtroom behavior.

topics.title: Hog Calling Contest & Iranian Remarks
topics.summary: During an off-the-rails conversation, hosts discuss a bizarre hog calling contest while simultaneously expressing controversial opinions about Iranians and their perceived lack of patriotism following a soccer match. The segment devolves into profane insults directed at callers and ultimately includes a discussion regarding Viagra.

topics.title: Stern’s Screener Impression Gone Wrong
topics.summary: Howard Stern directs a screener with stuttering to create a bizarre foreign impression for the show. The screener delivers nonsensical phrases, prompting Howard's commentary and escalating into crude remarks directed at Rosie O’Donnell who was in the audience.

topics.title: Shaq’s Unscripted Audience Interview
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio interview, Shaq attempts to teach himself basketball while fielding bizarre questions from an uncomprehending audience prone to nonsensical outbursts and strange wooing rituals. The segment devolves into a mix of self-doubt, awkward behavior, and fascination with commercialism, culminating in frantic attempts involving his daughter.”}

topics.title: Magic's Germ Phobia and Audience Questions
topics.summary: During a live show, host Howie Mandel discusses guest Magic Johnson’s germ phobias while discussing audience questions. The segment then shifts to Craig Melvin discussing language acquisition with the audience before transitioning to an extended interview about Shaq O’Neal’s dream role in ‘Terminator 3,’ and concluding with a bizarre conversation involving comic Paul Rodriguez who claims he was paid to laugh at Magic Johnson.
